notes.title: Update 1.2 - Language Support Update
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the language update for RoboCritters has gone live. With this update you can now play RoboCritters in any of the 20 supported languages (including German, Russian, French, Spanish and many more). Enjoy!

Wir freuen uns zu verkünden, dass das Sprach-Update für RoboCritters live gegangen ist. Mit diesem Update kannst du jetzt RoboCritters in einer der 20 unterstützten Sprachen (ua Russisch, Deutsch, Französisch, Spanisch und vieles mehr) spielen. Genießen!

Мы рады сообщить, что обновление языка для RoboCritters прошло вживую. С помощью этого обновления вы можете теперь играть RoboCritters на любом из 20 поддерживаемых языков (включая русский, немецкий, французский, испанский и многие другие). Наслаждайтесь!

Nous sommes heureux d'annoncer que la mise à jour de la langue de RoboCritters est entrée en vigueur. Avec cette mise à jour, vous pouvez maintenant jouer à RoboCritters dans l'une des 20 langues prises en charge (notamment le russe, l'allemand, le français, l'espagnol et bien d'autres encore). Prendre plaisir!

Estamos felices de anunciar que la actualización de idioma de RoboCritters ha entrado en funcionamiento. Con esta actualización ahora puede jugar RoboCritters en cualquiera de los 20 idiomas soportados (incluyendo ruso, alemán, francés, español y muchos más). ¡Disfrutar!

notes.title: Update 1.11 - Network Stability Improvements
notes.content:
Hey folks,

We've just pushed a minor update to address some network stability issues. Thanks to all those who have provided bug reports and/or got in touch with feedback.

Here's a list of items addressed in the patch:
* Fix for possible race condition crash on gamer leaving network game
* Fixed rare condition where missile belonging to recently left gamer could cause crash
* Improved thread safety so that network games are more cleanly shut down
* Fixed issue where host quitting could sometimes cause clients to crash 
* Various other networking stability improvements

Please keep your reports of any issues coming through and we'll do our best to resolve them as soon as we're aware. In the meantime, we'll be busy with our first feature update coming soon (Support for all 27 Steam languages).


Regards,
Curious Dimensions Team

notes.title: Hotfix - Non-Latin Steam Usernames Crash Fix
notes.content: We have identified and resolved an issue whereby Steam gamertags with 'non-latin' characters may have caused a game crash on entering a lobby.

notes.title: Releasing tomorrow (Want free copies for your friends?)
notes.content:
We're very exited that release time has finally come; RoboCritters will be released tomorrow (4th July) and to celebrate we are giving away 150 free keys. Be one of the first to help us to spread the word of RoboCritters and get 3 of these free copies for your friends. Simply upload at least 10 minutes of gameplay with commentary to YouTube and let us know about it. That's it!

Requirements:

 You must have at least 20 followers on YouTube
 Game must have 3-6 players
 You must have an email address listed in your 'about' section (we'll use this to send your keys)


Get in touch with us here - http://www.robo-critters.com/contact/

https://goo.gl/iQUBdf
